name: idle-leftover-track
what: rt-sync2g, live check sync2f f8 on 0.63.0: the desktop seemed to send a leftover test track ('LV c6twomovesaton Drums', made with the laptop's help in an earlier run) three times in 120 s with nobody editing, the laptop off. It was the live tool's own count (its events_since took the laptop's files, James-Laptop-*, for the desktop's, James-*), not StudioSync. This pins the StudioSync side: James makes a track, Bee changes it, Bee goes offline for good, and James's computer then sends nothing for minutes. Passes before and after rt-sync2g (a guard, not a reproduction).

edits.lua: F.add_track('LV leftover Drums'); return 'made LV leftover Drums'
reaper.SetMediaTrackInfo_Value(track('LV leftover Drums'), 'D_VOL', 0.5); return 'turned LV leftover Drums down'
local n = 0; for p in pairs(fs) do if p:find('/events/James%-%d') then n = n + 1 end end; N.james_sent = n; return 'James has sent ' .. n

checks.what: James sent nothing in the minutes after Bee went away
checks.lua: local n = 0; for p in pairs(fs) do if p:find('/events/James%-%d') then n = n + 1 end end; assert(N.james_sent and n == N.james_sent, 'James sent ' .. tostring(n - (N.james_sent or 0)) .. ' more event(s) with nobody editing')
